mapper.select: SELECT m_stores.store_id, m_stores.store_name, m_stores.email, m_stores.tel, m_stores.postal_code, m_stores.address, m_stores.opening_hours, m_stores.closed_days, m_stores.store_status, m_stores.note, user_accounts.login_id, user_accounts.password FROM m_stores INNER JOIN store_accounts ON m_stores.store_id = store_accounts.store_id INNER JOIN user_accounts ON store_accounts.account_id = user_accounts.account_id WHERE store_accounts.store_id = #{storeId};
SELECT store_name, email, tel, postal_code, address, opening_hours, closed_days, store_status, note FROM m_stores WHERE store_id = #{storeId};
SELECT store_id FROM m_stores ORDER BY store_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO m_stores( store_id, store_name, email, tel, postal_code, address, opening_hours, closed_days, store_status, note, created_at, updated_at, deleted_flag ) VALUE( #{storeId}, #{storeName}, #{email}, #{tel}, #{postalCode}, #{address}, #{openingHours}, #{closedDays}, #{storeStatus}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 );
mapper.update: UPDATE user_accounts SET login_id = #{account.loginId}, password = #{account.password}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = ( SELECT account_id FROM store_accounts WHERE store_id = #{storeId} );

UPDATE m_stores SET store_name = #{store.storeName}, email = #{store.email}, tel = #{store.tel}, postal_code = #{store.postalCode}, address = #{store.address}, opening_hours = #{store.openingHours}, closed_days = #{store.closedDays}, store_status = #{store.storeStatus}, note = #{store.note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m_stores.store_id, m_stores.store_name FROM m_books INNER JOIN store_books ON m_books.book_id = store_books.book_id INNER JOIN m_stores ON store_books.store_id = m_stores.store_id LEFT JOIN t_inventories ON m_books.book_id = t_inventories.book_id WHERE t_inventories.book_id IS NULL;
